missionSteps: Open the Grand Mission letter and lay out all 11 previous badges.
Name your Dream Town and choose its river, hills, and climate.
Zone neighbourhoods: homes, schools, markets, and parks.
Apply Architect & Interior rules to design 3 key town buildings.
Apply Urban Planner & Engineer skills for roads and river bridge.
Add a Landscape Designer bird sanctuary and shaded market square.
Create Graphic Designer shop signs and Eco waste stations.
Paint a Folk Artist town archway celebrating local craft.

Write a mini town guidebook using Storyteller binding skills.
Set up a living-room exhibition tour for friends and family.
Earn your final Dream Town Badge and Master Designer sign-off.

testimonials.quote: Before Jotter & Potter, weekends meant negotiating tablet time. After opening his sealed client letter, Aarav spent two hours measuring his grandmother's verandah and sketching ramps so she wouldn't have to climb steps.
What sets these apart from ordinary craft kits is the real client step. Having to explain her organizer prototype and fix why Version 1 tipped over taught Ira resilience without a single lecture.
Seeing Indian contexts—Channapatna wood, terracotta roofs, local kirana signboards, and grandparent interviews—made our son look at his own neighbourhood with genuine curiosity.

faqs.question: Is The Little Designer right for both 6-year-olds and 12-year-olds?
faqs.answer: Yes. Younger makers (ages 6–8) lean on the 24 picture-and-word cards, large colouring grids, and building side-by-side with a parent. Older children (ages 9–12) dive deeper into scaled measurements, client interviews, load-testing data, and independent prototyping.

faqs.question: How much adult help is needed each week?
faqs.answer: About 15–20 minutes on setup and cutting. Children handle drawing, matching cards, planning, and decorating on their own, while an adult assists whenever cutting thick cardboard walls, punching bookbinding holes, or blending recycled paper pulp.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take across India, and how do combos ship?
faqs.answer: Single packs and Explorer Combos dispatch within 48 hours and reach metro cities in 3–5 business days (5–7 days across India). The Designer Combo ships in two batches (Months 1–3, then 4–6), and the Master Designer Box ships quarterly so fresh folders arrive right as your child finishes.

faqs.question: Do we need to buy the Starter Kit separately?
faqs.answer: If you order any Combo (Explorer, Designer, or Master Designer Box), the Starter Kit is included free in your very first box. If you start with a single monthly pack, you can add the Starter Kit in one click or use household safety scissors, ruler, glue, and pencils.

faqs.question: What if a pack arrives damaged or a piece is missing?
faqs.answer: Write to us or message us on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery with a quick photo. We ship replacement sheets, wooden tools, or a fresh kraft folder free of charge anywhere in India.

faqs.question: Can we order a pack as a birthday gift?
faqs.answer: Yes! Both single packs and combo boxes include a complimentary Gift Tag option at checkout where we hand-write your personal message onto kraft cardstock inside the box.

resources.title: Meet the Architect – Free Sample Activity Sheet
resources.summary: Try the opening mission from Month 01 at your dining table tonight. Sketch a dream floor plan on our scaled grid with simple door, window, and verandah symbols.
content: Every great building starts with listening carefully to the people who will live inside it. Print this A4 sheet, grab a wooden ruler and two coloured pencils, and ask someone at home what makes their favourite room feel special.
Use the square grid to sketch walls from straight above—like a sparrow looking down without a roof. Leave wide openings for doors and mark sunny windows facing morning light.

resources.title: Neighbourhood Bird & Plant Observation Card
resources.summary: A weekend balcony tally sheet from Month 03 helping kids spot Indian sparrows, purple sunbirds, red-vented bulbuls, and flowering pollinators.
content: Set aside 15 quiet morning minutes near a window or balcony with a notebook and pencil. Count how many different birds visit between 7:30 AM and 8:00 AM.
Note whether each bird prefers shady railings, potted tulsi, or shallow water bowls—these clues tell young landscape designers exactly what to plant next.

resources.title: Why Designing for a Real Client Beats Filling Craft Worksheets
resources.summary: When a child builds for a grandparent, sibling, or neighbourhood shopkeeper, craft stops being busywork and becomes purposeful problem solving.
content: Most activity books ask children to copy a pre-drawn rabbit or colour inside fixed lines. Once finished, the page goes into a drawer.

At Jotter & Potter, every monthly pack begins with an unsealed envelope from someone your child knows or cares about. Suddenly, a 7-year-old pauses to ask: 'Can Dadi reach this shelf without bending?' or 'Will this bridge carry toy trains without wobbling?'
By shifting the focus from 'pretty output' to 'serving a real person', children naturally practice listening, patience, clear explanation, and pride in earning a signed certificate.

resources.title: How to Set Up a Calm 30-Minute Screen-Free Maker Rhythm
resources.summary: Practical tips from Indian parents on keeping craft mornings joyful—without buying expensive storage tubs or hovering over every scissor cut.
content: Keep one flat tray or kraft folder dedicated to the month's mission so work-in-progress models can move off the dining table in ten seconds before dinner.
Pair three word-and-colouring card pairs on weekday evenings (10 minutes) with one hands-on building step on Saturday or Sunday morning (30 minutes). Consistency beats marathon sessions every time.
